meta.name: Zone Two
meta.source: Original Aurisar layout. A cold moor plateau reached through Zone 1's northern pass; differentiated from Zone 1 by heightfield, biome weights and scatter density only — it reuses Zone 1's eight terrain layers and its one shared TerrainLit material (D159).
meta.units: 1 unit = 1 meter = 32 SpacetimeDB px; zone origin = ZoneDef.originOffsetM (zone 2 = +3000 m on x) = STDB (97600,1600)
meta.notes: M10 (D162) shipped this deliberately thin: three camps, one outpost, one switchback, scatter.chestCount 0. M11-4 (D168/D169/D176) is the content-parity fill: scatter.chestCount is now 12 (area-scaled against zone1_world.json's 25, D176) and a Windward Scarp exclusion + `anchors.barrowdeep` mark the Barrowdeep dungeon's exterior footprint (D169) — the dungeon interior itself is NOT built by this config, only its worldgen-level keep-out. NOTE for M11-2: these 12 chests are still not server-openable — scripts/emit_world_chests.mjs still reads zone1_world.json only, so the chest manifest itself must be parameterized per-zone (M11-2, blocked on this file landing) before any reducer can open one of these. Read by the Unity exporter as of M10-3 (scripts/lib/unity_export/content.mjs loops every zone's worldConfig); Zone 2's terrain was baked in M10-8, so export/unity-content/terrain/zone2_* now exists and mirrors this file's realized sites.

exclusions.note: Barrowdeep mound footprint + approach (barrowdeep/barrowdeepPlan.js EXTERIOR, D169/M11-5) — mirrors Zone 1's castle-entry exclusion
